integrity: All claimed infinite-cardinality equivalences follow from an explicitly proved cross-model bisimulation. Finite checker evidence is supporting only. Historical priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
scientific_limitations: Complete powersets of nonempty ground sets; disjointness modality; Boolean connectives; the unique fixed proposition is true exactly at singleton worlds. Arbitrary valuations, induced subframes, graded modal languages and compatibility frames are outside the claim.
title: Eight modal theories for atom-marked disjointness on complete powersets
